M-IF-S-001.mitigation: Implement hardware authentication (secure elements, cryptographic chips)

M-IF-T-001.mitigation: Physical tamper detection and secure boot mechanisms

M-IF-T-003.mitigation: Enclose interface in lockable, tamper-evident housing

M-IF-T-004.mitigation: Use potting compound or conformal coating to protect circuit traces

M-IF-R-001.mitigation: Log all physical interface access events with timestamps

M-IF-I-001.mitigation: Encrypt data on physical buses (CAN encryption, secure protocols)

M-IF-I-002.mitigation: Shield cables and use EMI protection to prevent eavesdropping

M-IF-D-001.mitigation: Implement physical protection (ESD protection, overcurrent protection, fuses)

M-IF-D-002.mitigation: Use redundant interfaces for critical functions

M-IF-D-003.mitigation: Implement rate limiting and lockout on interface to prevent brute-force and flooding attacks

M-IF-E-001.mitigation: Physically separate or remove debug interfaces in production units

M-IF-E-002.mitigation: Disable or protect debug interfaces in production (JTAG lock, fuse blowing)

M-IF-E-003.mitigation: Implement firmware signature verification and rollback protection

M-IF-DBG-002.mitigation: Enable memory readback protection (e.g. STM32 RDP1) to prevent firmware extraction via debug interface

M-IF-POLICY-001.mitigation: Decommission factory-only interfaces before production deployment — verify operationalState=permanent_disabled

M-IF-POLICY-002.mitigation: Enforce maintenance-window access policy — interface must be automatically disabled outside declared windows

M-IF-S-002.mitigation: Require password authentication before granting interface access

M-IF-S-003.mitigation: Require multi-factor authentication for interface access (CR 1.1 RE2)

M-IF-DBG-001.mitigation: Require authentication before granting debug access — restrict available commands to minimum required set

M-IF-DBG-003.mitigation: Permanently disable debug interface via OTP fuse before production deployment — irreversible lock

M-IF-D-004.mitigation: Lock interface after configurable number of failed authentication attempts — require manual reset or timeout

M-IF-MON-001.mitigation: Monitor interface access and generate alerts on suspicious activity — log all connection attempts
